greeting.title: CEO Message
greeting.desc: Thank you for visiting LUA Corporation.
body: Hello. I am Ryu Jina, CEO of LUA Corporation.
Demand for AI computing is growing rapidly, yet the power and infrastructure to support it remain insufficient. LUA was founded to address this with technology.

We develop both the facilities required to build a data center and the technology to operate them. The results are secured as patents, and alongside the technology we carry out site development ourselves.
We will continue to find our answers in technology. We ask you to follow the path LUA takes ahead. Thank you.
